findings.title: A genuine internal gain is learned at 54-57 % of its size; the heat-loss scale absorbs the rest (-2.75 %)
findings.claim: Driven together on a converged house with a genuine +0.6 kW evening gain (17-22 h) and zero-mean sensor noise, coordinator._fold_internal_gains settles the profile at 0.540-0.569 of the genuine gain over 15 noise x seed cells, while learner_newton_step moves house_heat_loss_scale to 0.9725 (truth 1.0) because both learners fold the same residual; with no genuine gain the profile stays within 0.009 kW of the prior and the scale within 1e-4.
findings.mechanism: _fold_internal_gains steps g += INTERNAL_GAINS_ALPHA*y - INTERNAL_GAINS_RIDGE*(g - g0) on the residual power y left after the live model (which carries the profile through _model_corrections), so its own fixed point is only alpha/(alpha+ridge) = 0.714 of the gain; the share it leaves unexplained is folded into the heat-loss scale on the same interval, which reads extra evening heat as a tighter house and, by lowering UA, explains part of the gain away from the profile (scale and a near-uniform gain offset are near-collinear under a 6 K diurnal swing).

evidence.unit: ratio (learned gain / genuine gain, mean over 3 noise arms x 5 seeds)
evidence.contention_note: fan-out, three seats on the box; seeded arithmetic, contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb-ridge0: coordinator.INTERNAL_GAINS_RIDGE = 0

findings.metric_definition: gain_recovery = mean over the gain hours of (learned profile g_h - prior g0) / (genuine gain), after 120 days of accepted dark intervals; identity 1
findings.phenomenon_property: On a converged heat-loss level, the internal-gains profile converges to a genuine hour-correlated gain and the heat-loss scale stays at the true UA: no learner settles on a fraction of a covariate the other learner absorbs.

null_control.note: with no genuine gain neither learner moves under zero-mean noise; the shortfall and the scale bias appear only with a genuine gain

reproduction_steps: Run the harness (about 1 min); read the CELL lines' gain_recovery_mean and scale_bias_genuine_mean per noise arm
Re-run with --perturb-ridge0: gain_recovery_mean rises 0.557 -> 0.775 (the ridge share); the rest is the scale's
The drifting arm's +0.06 scale under a +1.5 K outdoor drift is the scale reading a biased covariate (expected) and is not the claim
findings.proposed_fix_scope: coordinator: fold the gains profile as a zero-mean shape about the level the heat-loss scale owns (or fold the scale on the residual after the profile's hour term), and drop the ridge's bias at the fixed point (shrink the step, not the target)
